modules.title: Determine high-performing and/or scalable storage solutions

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: Amazon S3 provides object storage, Amazon EBS provides block storage for compute, and Amazon EFS or Amazon FSx provide managed file systems.

prompts.label: COMPARE
prompts.placeholder: The choices are visible. Reveal the differences one cell at a time.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

items: parallel HPC file system -> FSx for Lustre

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Network File System, a common shared-file protocol used by Linux and Unix systems.
Server Message Block, a file-sharing protocol commonly used by Windows workloads.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: EBS SSD volumes target transactional I/O where IOPS and latency matter. gp3 is general-purpose SSD; io2 targets demanding workloads that need high, predictable provisioned IOPS. HDD volumes target large sequential I/O: st1 is for frequently accessed throughput-heavy data, while sc1 is lower-cost storage for infrequently accessed sequential data.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Which workload signal points to each EBS type?

items: io2: high, predictable provisioned IOPS for demanding workloads.
st1: frequently accessed large sequential throughput.
sc1: infrequently accessed sequential HDD data.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Input/output operations per second; how many storage operations a volume can perform each second.
How much data a storage volume transfers per second.
Large reads or writes processed in order, where throughput is usually more important than small-I/O latency.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: AWS DataSync handles managed online transfer between supported storage systems. Storage Gateway provides ongoing hybrid storage interfaces. Snow Family remains useful for SAA exam recognition as the traditional AWS physical/offline transfer family, but Snow Family devices are no longer available to new customers.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Choose the service from how data must move or be accessed.

items: Managed online copy over network connectivity -> DataSync.
Ongoing hybrid storage interface -> Storage Gateway.
Exam-recognition of traditional AWS offline appliance transfer -> Snow Family.
For a new real-world design, check current alternatives because new customers cannot order Snow Family devices.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Moving data over network connectivity instead of shipping a physical device.
A design where on-premises systems and AWS storage are used together as one access pattern.

modules.title: Design high-performing and elastic compute solutions

nodes.title: EC2 instance families and workload fit

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: EC2 instance families balance compute, memory, storage, networking, and accelerator resources for different workload profiles.

prompts.label: TASK MAP
prompts.placeholder: Reveal each row and compare neighboring architecture choices.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: A group of EC2 instance types designed around a resource profile such as compute, memory, or storage.
A virtual CPU unit exposed to an EC2 instance.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: Lambda memory is also a performance control because AWS allocates CPU power in proportion to configured memory. Concurrency is the number of invocations running at the same time. Separate per-invocation speed from simultaneous invocation capacity.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Which Lambda symptom points to memory versus concurrency?

items: CPU-bound invocation is slow -> test a higher memory setting.
Traffic burst causes throttles -> inspect concurrency.
Increasing concurrency does not make one invocation execute faster.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: The number of Lambda invocations running at the same time.
A rejected request because a concurrency or service limit has been reached.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: AWS Batch manages batch job scheduling, ECS and EKS orchestrate containers, Fargate runs containers without managing servers, and Lambda runs event-driven functions.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Choose compute from the execution model.

items: Queued parallel batch jobs -> AWS Batch.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Non-interactive work that can be queued and processed later, often in parallel.
Managing where containers or jobs run and coordinating their lifecycle.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What makes a useful scaling metric?

reveal.text: A scaling metric should track demand in a way that changes meaningfully with capacity. Typical signals include average CPU for CPU-bound fleets, ALB RequestCountPerTarget for request-driven web tiers, queue backlog per worker for asynchronous workers, and Lambda concurrency/throttles for simultaneous serverless demand.

prompts.label: COMPARE
prompts.placeholder: Match workload to scaling signal.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What wording should trigger scaling-metric reasoning?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: An Auto Scaling policy that adjusts capacity to keep a selected metric near a target value.
Queue backlog divided by running workers; often a better scaling signal than total queue depth alone.
An ALB metric measuring average requests sent to each target.

nodes.title: Relational, key-value, graph, document, and warehouse databases

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: Choose databases from the data model and access pattern. RDS/Aurora fit relational OLTP, DynamoDB fits key-value/document access at scale, DocumentDB provides MongoDB-compatible document behavior, Neptune fits graph relationships, Redshift is an analytical warehouse, and Aurora Serverless v2 provides elastic relational compute within an ACU range.

prompts.label: TASK MAP
prompts.placeholder: Reveal each row and compare neighboring architecture choices.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

items: variable relational compute -> Aurora Serverless v2

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Online transaction processing: frequent application transactions such as orders or account updates.
Online analytical processing: large analytical queries for reporting and insights.
A database optimized for entities and relationships between them.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: Amazon ElastiCache provides general in-memory caching, while DynamoDB Accelerator is a DynamoDB-compatible cache designed for microsecond read access to DynamoDB data.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: When do DAX and ElastiCache differ?

items: General in-memory cache for SQL results, sessions, APIs, or multiple systems -> ElastiCache.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: A request answered from the cache instead of the original data source.
A request whose data is absent from the cache and must be fetched from the source.

nodes.title: Read replicas, Aurora readers, and RDS Proxy

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: Read replicas and Aurora reader instances scale read traffic, while RDS Proxy primarily improves connection management and reuse.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Choose read scaling versus connection management.

items: Aurora read scaling -> Aurora reader instances/reader endpoint.
Too many short-lived DB connections -> RDS Proxy.
Asynchronous replicas can have replica lag.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide
Working with DB instance read replicas

glossary.definition: The delay before a change on a source database appears on an asynchronous replica.
A reusable set of database connections shared by application requests.

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: How do access patterns drive capacity choices?

reveal.text: DynamoDB on-demand capacity fits variable request traffic without explicit RCU/WCU provisioning. Provisioned mode fits predictable throughput managed with RCU/WCU values. Aurora Serverless v2 uses an ACU range for elastic relational capacity. Poor DynamoDB partition-key distribution can still create a hot partition.

prompts.label: COMPARE
prompts.placeholder: Choose the capacity model from traffic predictability.

prompts.label: EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: What phrases should trigger capacity reasoning?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Read capacity unit used by DynamoDB provisioned capacity.
Write capacity unit used by DynamoDB provisioned capacity.
Aurora capacity unit used by Aurora Serverless v2.
A DynamoDB partition receiving disproportionate traffic and becoming a bottleneck.

modules.title: Determine high-performing and/or scalable network architectures

prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Content delivery network; a distributed edge network used to serve content close to users.
A routing method where the same IP address is advertised from multiple locations.

prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: ALB provides Layer 7 HTTP routing, NLB provides high-performance Layer 4 TCP and UDP load balancing, and GWLB integrates fleets of network virtual appliances.

Application-layer routing based on HTTP information such as host, path, or headers.
The encapsulation protocol used by Gateway Load Balancer for network-appliance integration.

nodes.title: Direct Connect, VPN, Transit Gateway, and PrivateLink

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What should this concept make you think of?

reveal.text: Direct Connect provides dedicated connectivity, Site-to-Site VPN provides encrypted IPsec connectivity, Transit Gateway acts as a network transit hub, and PrivateLink exposes services privately through endpoints.

prompts.label: WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Which network requirement points to each service?

items: Many networks need a central hub -> Transit Gateway.
Private service exposure through interface endpoints -> PrivateLink.

prompts.placeholder: What phrase should make this answer jump out?

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: A protocol suite used to encrypt network traffic, including Site-to-Site VPN tunnels.
A central routing design where many networks connect through a shared hub.

nodes.title: Network topology, routing, and IP capacity

prompts.label: WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: What makes a VPC topology scale cleanly?

reveal.text: Performance and scalability depend on subnet placement, route paths, IP address capacity, and how networks connect. CIDR ranges need growth headroom, routed networks should avoid overlapping CIDRs, and many VPCs often scale better through a transit hub than through a large mesh.

prompts.label: COMPARE
prompts.placeholder: Match symptom to the design concern.

source_refs.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (SAA-C03) exam guide

glossary.definition: Notation describing an IP address range, such as 10.0.0.0/16.
Rules that determine where traffic is sent based on its destination.
Two connected networks using intersecting IP ranges, making normal routing ambiguous.
